Hi Alicia — great questions. I pulled together a short checklist and initial SKU map for Acme and attached them. Summary below:

1) Claiming procedure (high level):
   - Redwood issues the private offer to GCP and we submit the entitlement file once the PO is signed.
   - GCP creates a private-offer entitlement ID (you’ll see this in the marketplace UI).
   - Monthly drawdown is done via committed usage against that entitlement ID; your billing system will receive charges per the SKU mapping.

2) Operational checklist (attached: GCP_PO_Claiming_Checklist_v1.pdf):
   - Signed PO (PDF) uploaded to the Cloud Partner team
   - Entitlement ID confirmation from GCP (we’ll request and share)
   - SKU mapping confirmation (attached workbook for your review)
   - First-month consumption flag — if you frontload credits, they show up on month 1; otherwise consumption ramps per usage.

3) Reconciliation & HubSpot:
   - Redwood will push monthly summary files to the HubSpot deal record (HubSpot: hs-deal-1083) and also provide a CSV export for your finance team. We can also send a manual mapping file on request.

Next steps I propose:
- Ops call to walk procurement through the checklist (30 minutes).
- Review the attached SKU mapping and mark any line items that don’t align.

Marissa / Ben / Karthik — looping you in for pricing/redlines and invoice cadence questions.

Best,

Thanks — quick note on the invoice cadence and financial controls:

- Invoice timing: Redwood issues monthly invoices aligned to the calendar month. For private-offer draws we can configure either an invoice upon consumption or a monthly statement that aggregates usage. Please confirm which Acme prefers.
- Frontload handling: If Acme elects frontloaded credits in month 1 we will show a one-line credit on the invoice and then monthly usages will reduce that balance.
- Reporting: We will deliver the monthly CSV by the 5th business day of the following month. The CSV will include entitlement_id, SKU, units_consumed, unit_price, and total_charge.

Action items for Acme: please confirm preferred invoice mode ("consume-invoice" vs "monthly-statement") and whether finance wants the CSV delivered to a shared SFTP or via secure email. If SFTP, we need host + account details.

Ben
